name: Citi_Extensions_WordDocument
label: Word Document
description: A Microsoft Word-like document editor with formatting, tables, comments, track changes, find & replace, and export.

properties.name: commentsPropName
properties.label: Comments (Page List property)
properties.helpText: Bind to a Page List property backed by Data-WordComment (e.g. .DocumentComments). Each comment and its replies are stored as individual embedded pages.

properties.name: versionsPropName
properties.label: Versions (Page List property)
properties.helpText: Bind to a Page List property backed by Data-WordVersion (e.g. .DocumentVersions). Each edit burst saves a full HTML snapshot, letting users restore any previous version.
